verdict.rationale: The evidence only documents Vapi exposing its own APIs as an MCP server (docs-5, docs-33, docs-37, probe-2) so external MCP clients like Claude Desktop can call Vapi — this is the reverse direction of the story. There is no evidence that Vapi assistants can consume or plug in external MCP servers to use their tools; custom tools are described only via webhooks (docs-6, docs-20, docs-34), not MCP.
